newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Treasury lowers 10-yr bond coupon to 7.35%.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Treasury lowers 10-yr bond coupon to 7.35%.

text.p: The Spanish Treasury launched on Monday a new 10-year bond, lowering the coupon to 7.35 percent from the 8.80 percent of the previous issue.
The new bond will be issued on 16 December 1996 and is due on 31 March 2007. The first coupon is due on 31 March 1998.
The 10-year benchmark 8.80 percent was trading at 0845 GMT at 109.80 from 109.90 at Friday's close.
